_note: Fictional candidate for demos. Not a real person.

facts.text: Senior Backend Engineer at Lumen Pay (fintech), 2021-2025, on the payments platform team of 6 engineers.
Led the migration of webhook delivery from a cron poller to an event queue on Kafka, cutting median delivery latency from 40s to 2s.
Designed idempotency keys for the refunds API after duplicate refunds reached 0.3% of requests.
Owned the on-call runbook rewrite; pages per week dropped from 14 to 5 over one quarter.
Mentored 2 junior engineers through their first production launches.
Disagreed with the product lead on shipping refunds without idempotency; proposed a two-week delay with a risk write-up, which the VP approved.
Backend Engineer at Northwind Logistics, 2018-2021, building shipment-tracking APIs in Python and PostgreSQL.
Added read replicas and query indexes that brought p95 tracking-API latency from 900ms to 180ms.
Wrote the postmortem for a 3-hour tracking outage caused by a schema migration lock.

stories.title: Webhook queue migration
stories.situation: Webhook delivery ran on a cron poller and merchants saw long delays.
stories.task: I led moving delivery to an event queue.
stories.action: Moved delivery onto Kafka with retries.
stories.result: Median delivery latency went from 40s to 2s.

stories.title: Pushing back on refunds launch
stories.situation: Duplicate refunds were 0.3% of requests and product wanted to ship a new refunds flow.
stories.task: Make the risk visible and propose a safer path.
stories.action: Wrote a risk write-up and proposed a two-week delay to add idempotency keys.

stories.title: Taming on-call
stories.result: Pages per week dropped from 14 to 5 over one quarter.
